text:
nicole_cs: Flagging — BeaconFoods has gone quiet. Active seats dropped ~60% over 8 days and their champion (Evan L) left last Wednesday. Procurement pinged about a bakeoff with VendorQ. Possible renewal risk.

paul_csm: Ugh. renewal window? billing issues?

nicole_cs: Renewal in 26 days. Billing clean. CRM shows Evan removed; new lead is Kira but no replies to outreach.

devon_eng: Any perf errors or 429 spikes? I can check quickly.

nicole_cs: No errors. Most drop from batch embedding jobs and webhook consumers.

alert-bot: reminder: renewal-30d alert sent to @maria_rev and @paul_csm for account beaconfoods.

maria_rev: looping in renewals — if procurement is shortlisting VendorQ we should offer a short pilot + usage credits. Need current consumption vs committed tiers and top endpoints.

paul_csm: Proposed playbook: 1) 48h personalized outreach + small credit 2) tech health check w/Devon 3) pilot + ROI one-pager from Maria. Agree? :thinking_face: 

nicole_cs: +1. also request Redwood Optimize quickscan to show batching/quant wins. I'll add asks to CRM (top-10 endpoints, last-30d seat churn, recent deploys).

devon_eng: I'll pull token/endpoint breakdown and prep a short quantization demo. Need 48h to gather traces.

maria_rev: I'll draft a 6-week pilot offer contingent on usage commitment and prepare competitor cost comparison.

paul_csm: I'll schedule outreach tomorrow afternoon. Nicole, lead the contact. Tag account as "at-risk: renewal window" in CRM.

nicole_cs: Done. Outreach scheduled. Kira auto-replied OOO but open to a meeting next week. Will update thread after call. :white_check_mark:
